_comment: ROUTER-side registry: admission facts only (deploy to the router state dir, or point MCP_REGISTRY at it). Git is the reviewed source of truth. command/args/env intentionally do NOT live here — they belong to each node's own node.json "mcpServers" allowlist (see mcp-registry.example.node.json), so a compromised router can never select a program to run on a node. class must be 'read-only' or 'side-effecting'; side-effecting calls additionally need a Mick-issued grant ID (bin/agent-bus-grant) and are otherwise hard-rejected. Address hosts by their stable node name, never by tailnet IP.

servers.name: inventory
servers.description: Read-only infra inventory (generated, secret-free export of aikeys assets — no credentials)

servers.name: web-tools
servers.description: z.ai web search + reader for clients without built-in search (key stays on the hosting node)
